```{r setup}
library(dtlscores)
library(dplyr, warn.conflicts = FALSE)
library(ggplot2)
```

Für uns sind die Teams der zweiten Bundesliga Süd in 2026 von Interesse:

```{r team_overview}
teams <- c("Exquisa Oberbayern", "TSV Monheim", "TT Buttenwiesen-Inningen", "VfL Kirchheim unter Teck", "TSV Unterföhring", "TSV Pfuhl", "TG Hanauerland", "KTV Ries") # nolint

routines |>
  filter(team %in% teams, end_value > 0) |>
  group_by(competition_url) |>
  filter(n() == 24) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(team, competition_url, end_value) |>
  unique() |>
  left_join(competitions, by = join_by(competition_url)) |>
  filter(season == "2025") |>
  group_by(team) |>
  summarize(
    league = unique(league),
    total = mean(end_value) * 24
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(total)) |>
  rename(
    Team = "team",
    `Liga 2025` = "league",
    `Durschn. Endwert` = "total"
  ) |>
  gt::gt()
```

Stellt sich jetzt halt die Frage, wie ist das Ergebnis pro Gerät und wie würde sich Monheim schlagen:


```{r}
routines |>
  filter(team %in% teams) |>
  left_join(competitions, by = join_by(competition_url)) |>
  filter(season == "2025") |>
  summarize(
    total = mean(end_value) * 4,
    .by = c(team, event)
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = event, values_from = total) |>
  mutate(total = rowSums(across(-1), na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(desc(total)) |>
  gt::gt()



routines |>
  filter(team %in% teams) |>
  left_join(competitions, by = join_by(competition_url)) |>
  filter(season == "2025") |>
  summarize(
    total = mean(end_value) * 4,
    .by = c(team, event)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    diff = total - total[team == "TSV Monheim"],
    .by = c(event)
  ) |>
  select(-c(total)) |>
  mutate(diff = case_when(diff < 0 ~ 2, diff == 0 ~ 1, diff > 0 ~ 0)) |>
  filter(!team == "TSV Monheim") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = event, values_from = diff) |>
  mutate(total = rowSums(across(-1), na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(total) |>
  gt::gt()
```
